basic_details.job_title: NAM NAM Kerala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Cook, Nurse and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National AYUSH Mission, Kannur (നാഷണൽ ആയുഷ് മിഷൻ, കണ്ണൂർ) is making temporary appointments on a contract basis, through district-level selection, to six posts in Kannur district: Nurse, Ayurveda Therapist (Male), Yoga Instructor, Cook, Unani Therapist and Multi Purpose Health Worker. The pay ranges from 10,500/- for Cook to 17,850/- for Nurse. Eligible candidates must apply online on careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 19/11/2026; the interview date will then be informed by email/SMS.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is counted as on 01-11-2026 . | Post Age Limit Nurse, Ayurveda Therapist (Male), Cook, Unani Therapist, Multi Purpose Health Worker Must not exceed 40 years as on 01-11-2026 Yoga Instructor Must not exceed 50 years as on 01-11-2026 | The notices do not mention any age relaxation. The Ayurveda Therapist post is advertised for men ("Ayurveda Therapist – Male"). Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

qualification.details: The notice for Yoga Instructor lists these qualifications, separated by "/": | Degree in BNYS/BAMS from a Government-recognised university MSc (Yoga) MPhil (Yoga) PG Diploma in Yoga of not less than one year from a Government-recognised university Certificate course of one year duration in Yoga from a recognised university or a Government department YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Diploma in Yogic Science and Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala Certificate Course in Yoga (of one year duration) | The same notice then adds: must have passed a Yoga Teacher Training Course (DYT course) of not less than one year from the State Resource Centre.

content_sections.heading: About NAM Kannur
content_sections.text: The National AYUSH Mission office in Kannur is run by the District Programme Manager and works from the B-Block, second floor, Civil Station, Kannur. The notices for these posts were issued on 12.11.2026 and signed by Dr. Hareesh Krishnan P P, District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Kannur. The posts are in AYUSH institutions of the district, including Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) centres and the Government Homoeopathy Hospital, Aralam.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notices print a number for three posts, which together come to 10 vacancies. For Nurse, Ayurveda Therapist (Male) and Unani Therapist, the notices say only "expected vacancy" without a number. The notices state that the number of vacancies is temporary and subject to change.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice for Yoga Instructor lists these qualifications, separated by "/": Degree in BNYS/BAMS from a Government-recognised university MSc (Yoga) MPhil (Yoga) PG Diploma in Yoga of not less than one year from a Government-recognised university Certificate course of one year duration in Yoga from a recognised university or a Government department YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Diploma in Yogic Science and Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala Certificate Course in Yoga (of one year duration) The same notice then adds: must have passed a Yoga Teacher Training Course (DYT course) of not less than one year from the State Resource Centre. The upper age limit is counted as on 01-11-2026 . The notices do not mention any age relaxation. The Ayurveda Therapist post is advertised for men ("Ayurveda Therapist – Male"). Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: BSc Nursing/GNM Nursing from a recognised university. Must have Kerala Nursing & Midwife Council registration.
Must have passed the Kerala Government's Ayurveda Therapist Course (DAME) of not less than one year / an Ayurveda Therapist Course of not less than one year from NARIP Cheruthuruthy.
Any one of the qualifications listed below the table.
Must have passed the Kerala Government DAME's Certificate Course in Unani Regimental Therapy.
GNM Nursing qualification from a recognised nursing school. Must have Kerala Nursing and Midwife Council registration.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for all six posts of NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026 is through an interview, described in the notices as a walk-in interview held after the online application. The interview date is not printed in the notices. It will be sent to candidates by email/SMS. The interview is held at the AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager office, B-Block, second floor, Civil Station, Kannur. The notices do not give a reporting time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notices print 10 vacancies: Yoga Instructor 2, Cook 1 and Multi Purpose Health Worker 7. Nurse, Ayurveda Therapist (Male) and Unani Therapist are listed as expected vacancies without a number.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online on careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 19/11/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NAM Kannur Nurse and Multi Purpose Health Worker posts?
faq.answer: Nurse needs BSc Nursing/GNM Nursing from a recognised university, and Multi Purpose Health Worker needs GNM Nursing from a recognised nursing school. Both posts require Kerala Nursing and Midwife Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age must not exceed 40 years as on 01-11-2026 for Nurse, Ayurveda Therapist (Male), Cook, Unani Therapist and Multi Purpose Health Worker. For Yoga Instructor, age must not exceed 50 years as on 01-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for NAM Kannur posts?
faq.answer: Nurse 17,850/-, Multi Purpose Health Worker 15000/-, Ayurveda Therapist (Male) 14700/-, Unani Therapist 14700/-, Yoga Instructor 14000/- and Cook 10,500/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 19/11/2026. The interview date will be sent by email/SMS.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NAM Kannur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview at the AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager office, B-Block, second floor, Civil Station, Kannur, on a date informed by email/SMS.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the NAM Kannur interview?
faq.answer: Bring original certificates proving qualification, age and address, along with self-attested copies of these certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Are the NAM Kannur posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notices state that the appointments are temporary and on a contract basis, made through district-level selection.

faq.question: Q10. Where are the NAM Kannur Multi Purpose Health Worker posts?
faq.answer: The 7 posts are at Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) centres in Anjarakandy, Aralam, Kodiyeri, Mokeri, Thayyil, Vellora and Kuttiattoor, one at each centre.
